notes.title: Supports SteamDeck resolution!
notes.content: Now supports Steam Deck's 16:10 resolution (1280x800) screen mode.

notes.title: New Game Mode Added! Available from February 16th
notes.content:
We will be adding a new game mode in addition to the existing 2-minute and 5-minute modes.

While the game has had a relatively gentle difficulty level, the high score rankings have become saturated. To provide a more competitive experience, we are introducing a mode with increased difficulty during gameplay.

Look forward to changes in ground object graphics and placements, as well as new attacks from airborne enemies!

※ Screenshots are from a work-in-progress version.

notes.title: January 31st Update
notes.content:
An EXIT menu has been added.
This allows you to exit the app from the title screen without using the ESC key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45364687/1d879a5bd2d79cec92eba325c17b9af3c0ac89b3.png[/img]

notes.title: January 20th Update
notes.content:
We've changed the method to one that doesn't use vertical sync.
This cannot be confirmed in a development environment, so please let us know if you encounter any problems.

notes.title: New Feature: View Ranking Data on Steam Client!
notes.content:
We've added a new feature! You can now check your scores and compare them with other players in the rankings directly on the Steam client. This allows you to track your progress and see how you stack up in real-time. Make sure to check it out!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/3324560/leaderboards/14965070/]https://steamcommunity.com/stats/3324560/leaderboards/14965070/[/url]
